identificationModule.briefTitle: Weekly Utidelone in HER2-negative Inoperable Locally Advanced or Metastatic Breast Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: Weekly Utidelone in HER2-negative Inoperable Locally Advanced or Metastatic Breast Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a phase II trial to explore the efficacy and safety of weekly utidelone in HER2-negative inoperable locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer.

conditions: Locally Advanced or Metastatic Breast Cancer

armGroups.label: Utidelone
armGroups.description: Drug: utidelone Utidelone Injection: 65 mg/m2/day, IV on day 1, 8, and 15 every 28 days

interventions.name: utidelone
interventions.description: Utidelone Injection: 65 mg/m2/day, IV on day 1, 8, and 15 every 28 days

primaryOutcomes.description: PFS is defined as the duration from enrollment to the first radiologically confirmed progressive disease (PD) (RECIST 1.1 criteria) or death due to any cause.

secondaryOutcomes.description: The proportion of patients with a best response of CR or PR, according to RECIST 1.1 criteria
From enrollment to death (for any reason)
The first evaluation of CR or PR to progression or death (for any reason)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Overall summary of adverse events following intravenous administration of utidelone (safety analysis set)
secondaryOutcomes.description: Incidence of treatment-emergent adverse events based the Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) version 5.0\[ Time Frame: 1 years\] Observe and record incidence of adverse events and severe adverse events associated with utidelone treatment, assessed by investigators according to CTCAE version 5.0.
